a.text: Being upfront before we act: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice to reach 8, then take) means we'd both very likely die holding 0 cells. The reserve only has 4, enough to protect one of us in round 1. I'm going to take 4 in round 1. If we both take, the split is random and we'll likely both end up short. If there's no storm, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can reach 4. I'd rather say this now than break our agreement quietly.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. Your message was sent before you saw mine, so I'm sorry if this lands badly. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round from now on so the reserve can rebuild for you. Take as soon as it reaches 4, and I won't take anything more.
